title: 第8章  那我可就等着喽
content_zh:
清晨，日出东方。
紫幕神山，杂役弟子处。
在山脉中历练了一晚的苏烬生回到住处，盘腿在床榻上，拿出下品灵石吞噬了起来。
每日清晨，所有杂役弟子必须要在住处，以便杂役总管派发任务。
若非如此的话，苏烬生是不会回来的。
昨日在吞噬完夜行猛虎之后，又猎杀了一头一级初期妖兽，火角虎！
神秘种子吞噬之后，境界成功突破至炼气五重境，整个人的实力再次提升五倍不止！
如今他依靠刚猛的灵气，强劲的体魄，轻而易举可越一重境界战斗。
面对炼气七重境武者，应当也是有一战之力的。
只可惜，外门弟子考核只会在每个月月初进行，还需要再等个二十天才行。
所以，当下他依旧是杂役弟子，需听从杂役总管的吩咐。
他预计，今日杂役总管就会派一些艰难具有危险的任务给他。
以便杂役总管为自己儿子报仇雪恨。
不过，他也不惧，凭借他当前的实力，所有杂役弟子的任务都能轻易完成。
也不担心会有人出手截杀，除非是杂役总管亲自动手，否则，没有哪个杂役弟子是他的对手。
甚至，就连一些外门弟子，也可轻易击败。
“砰……砰砰……”
略微有力的敲门声响起。
苏烬生神色微微一凝，心中猜测到是有任务要来了，随即便收起下品灵石，走了出去。
没想到，这一次的任务竟然是杂役总管胡羽丰亲自派发！

胡羽丰面色阴沉，眼中带有血丝，一副气愤之色毫不遮掩。
昨日发现胡荣身亡之后，一夜未眠，心中犹如烈火般燃烧，一直未灭。
那可是他的亲生儿子，独苗，就此丧命山脉之中，这让他如何能够接受？
一夜调整之后，便开始实施复仇计划！
他一定要让苏烬生承受断筋断骨之痛！
“苏烬生，今日给你派发任务，与林月舒一同前往灵药峰，种植灵药！”
“这是你与林月舒的任务令牌！”
闻言，苏烬生的面色也是一沉，想不到，这个老东西竟然将仇恨牵连到了林月舒的身上！
这灵药峰的长老，脾气古怪，性格残暴，经常会有种植灵药的杂役弟子被打残打废抬出来。
主要还是种植灵药的存活率太低了，平常种下去十株灵药，能有三株存活就不错了。
这就大大的浪费了灵药苗。
而这些灵药苗对于长老来说，珍贵无比，每浪费一株都宛若割肉般疼痛。
所以，这汹涌怒火自然就出在诸多杂役弟子的头上了。
炼药长老也尝试过亲自种植，但是一个人速度太慢，又要为宗门炼制丹药，根本没有时间。
只能将这些杂活交由杂役弟子去做了。
但是，诸多杂役弟子每听到这种植灵药的任务后，都是想尽办法逃脱，生怕被打的残废。
“知道了总管，我们这就前往灵药峰！”
苏烬生接过令牌，面色有些难看出声。
虽然他先前与这炼药长老有过几面之缘，但并无交情，此次任务，恐怕不太好完成。
不过，既然杂役总管已经派发任务，他便只能前去，否则，将会被逐出宗门。

希望炼药长老还能
“此次任务共要三天，三天后傍晚，到任务栏上交任务！”
胡羽丰面色依旧难看，双目中满是恨意，言语一声之后，便直接转身离开了。
他倒要看看，三日之后，苏烬生还能不能好好的站在这里！
还有那个林月舒，他也不会放过。
只要是和苏烬生有关系的人，他一个都不会放过！
也只有这样，才能告慰他儿胡荣的在天之灵！
苏烬生望着其消失的背影，眼中杀意一闪而逝，心中暗道。
老东西，用不了一个月的时间，就让你去陪你那个儿子去！
思索一句之后，便关上院门，朝着林月舒的住处走去。
在得知要去灵药峰种植灵药之时，林月舒的面色不由得难看几分。
“烬生哥哥，我听说那个炼药长老极其残暴，我们必须要小心一些才行！”
“不过也是奇怪，这种任务，那个杂役总管怎么会交给我们呢？”
说到这里，林月舒的面色露出一副凶狠之色，咬牙切齿道。
“肯定是因为胡荣那个王八蛋，不然的话，这种任务只会交给境界较高的杂役的弟子！”
“胡荣已经死了！”
苏烬生神色肃穆，淡然出声，仿佛与自己没有关系一样。
“啊！？”
林月舒面露震惊之色，双目圆瞪，脑海飞速转动。
当察觉到苏烬生已经达到炼气五重境之时，心中瞬间清楚了事情的原委。

虽然她境界从未曾突破，但天生聪慧，轻易便可猜测到其中的一切。
不过，她却并未再提及，不然的话，只会让苏烬生心生愧疚，因此而连累到自己。
反而是面露笑容，吃惊开口道。
“烬生哥哥丹田恢复之后，天赋比先前还要厉害，这才不到三天时间，就已突破至炼气五重境！”
“相信要不了一年时间，就能够重回巅峰！”
不到三天，接连突破四重境界，这等速度，足以载入紫幕神山的史册了！
苏烬生自然知道林月舒心中所想，但也并未点破，而是淡然笑道。
“那是肯定的，到时候我还会保护你！”
“就算是杂役总管也不敢随意给你派发任务！”
杂役总管虽然在杂役弟子中最大，但是对于内门弟子来说，不过蝼蚁罢了。
先前苏烬生为内门弟子第一人之时，每次前去看望林月舒的时候。
那胡羽丰都会前来巴结谄媚。
更会照顾林月舒，不给其派发一点任务。
可以说，前几年的林月舒在杂役弟子中，就差被供起来了。
“那我可就等着喽！”
林月舒表面上欣喜出声，心中却是暗道，其实，那几年也挺无聊的。
没有什么朋友，整天就是闲逛，修炼也一直不能突破。
最开心的时候就是苏烬生来看望她的时候，那样，这生活也就不那么无聊了。
content_en:
Early in the morning, the sun rises in the east.
Purple Curtain Mountain, where the servant disciples are.
Su Jinsheng, who had been practicing in the mountains for a night, returned to his residence, crossed his legs on the bed, took out the low-grade spiritual stone and swallowed it.
Every morning, all handyman disciples must be at their residences so that the handyman master can assign tasks.
Otherwise, Su Jinsheng would not have come back.
Yesterday, after devouring the nocturnal tiger, I hunted another first-level early-stage monster, the Fire Horned Tiger!
After swallowing the mysterious seeds, his realm successfully broke through to the fifth level of Qi refining, and his overall strength increased more than five times again!
Now he relies on his strong spiritual energy and strong body to easily surpass the first level of fighting.
He should be able to fight against a warrior at the seventh level of Qi Refining.
It's a pity that the outer disciples' assessment will only be conducted at the beginning of each month, so they have to wait another twenty days.
Therefore, at present, he is still a handyman disciple and needs to obey the instructions of the handyman chief.
He expected that today the head janitor would assign him some difficult and dangerous tasks.
So that the handyman could avenge his son.
However, he is not afraid. With his current strength, all the tasks of the handyman disciples can be easily completed.
There is no need to worry that someone will intercept and kill him. Unless the head servant does it himself, no servant disciple can be his opponent.
Even some outer disciples can be defeated easily.
"Bang...bang bang..."
There was a slightly forceful knock on the door.
Su Jinsheng's expression condensed slightly, and he guessed that a mission was coming, so he immediately put away the low-grade spiritual stones and walked out.
Unexpectedly, the task this time was actually dispatched by Hu Yufeng, the handyman in charge!
Hu Yufeng's face was gloomy, his eyes were bloodshot, and he looked unabashedly angry.
After discovering Hu Rong's death yesterday, I stayed up all night, burning like a fire in my heart that never went out.
That was his biological son, Du Miao, who died in the mountains. How could he accept this?
After a night of adjustments, the revenge plan began!
He must let Su Jinsheng bear the pain of broken muscles and bones!
"Su Jinsheng, I will assign you a task today. Go to the Spiritual Medicine Peak with Lin Yueshu to plant the spiritual medicine!"
"This is your and Lin Yueshu's mission token!"
Hearing this, Su Jinsheng's face also darkened. Unexpectedly, this old man would actually implicate his hatred towards Lin Yueshu!
The elder of the Spiritual Medicine Peak had a weird temper and a cruel personality. The handyman disciples who planted the spiritual medicine were often beaten, beaten and carried out.
The main reason is that the survival rate of planting elixirs is too low. Normally, out of ten elixir plants, it would be good to have three survive.
This was a huge waste of the elixir seedlings.
These elixir seedlings are extremely precious to the elders, and every wasted one is as painful as cutting flesh.
Therefore, this raging anger naturally came from the heads of many handyman disciples.
The medicine refining elder also tried to plant it himself, but it was too slow for one person and he had to refine elixirs for the sect, so there was no time at all.
These chores can only be left to the handyman disciples.
However, every time many handyman disciples heard about the task of planting elixirs, they tried their best to escape, for fear of being beaten and crippled.
"I know the manager, let's go to the Spiritual Medicine Peak!"
Su Jinsheng took the token, his face a bit hard to read.
Although he had met the medicine refining elder several times before, he had no friendship. I am afraid it would not be easy to complete this mission.
However, since the general manager has assigned the task, he has no choice but to go, otherwise, he will be expelled from the sect.
I hope the alchemy elder can still
"This mission will take three days in total. In the evening after three days, go to the taskbar and hand in the mission!"
Hu Yufeng's face was still ugly, and his eyes were full of hatred. After speaking, he turned and left.
He wanted to see if Su Jinsheng could still stand here properly in three days!
And that Lin Yueshu, heI won't let it go either.
As long as they are related to Su Jinsheng, he will not let anyone go!
Only in this way can we comfort his son Hu Rong’s spirit in heaven!
Su Jinsheng looked at his disappearing back, murderous intent flashed in his eyes, and he thought to himself.
Old man, it won’t take more than a month for you to accompany your son!
After thinking for a while, he closed the courtyard door and walked towards Lin Yueshu's residence.
When she learned that she was going to the elixir peak to plant elixirs, Lin Yueshu couldn't help but look a little ugly.
"Brother Jinsheng, I heard that the alchemy elder is extremely cruel, we must be more careful!"
"But it's also strange. Why would the handyman in charge give us such a task?"
Having said this, Lin Yueshu's face showed a fierce expression and she gritted her teeth.
"It must be because of that bastard Hu Rong, otherwise, this kind of task would only be given to disciples of higher-level handymen!"
"Hu Rong is dead!"
Su Jinsheng looked solemn and spoke calmly, as if it had nothing to do with him.
"Ah!?"
Lin Yueshu looked shocked, her eyes widened, and her mind was spinning rapidly.
When he realized that Su Jinsheng had reached the fifth level of Qi refining, he instantly understood the whole story.
Although her realm has never been broken through, she is naturally intelligent and can easily guess everything.
However, she did not mention it again, otherwise, it would only make Su Jinsheng feel guilty and implicate herself.
Instead, he smiled and said in surprise.
"After Brother Jinsheng recovered his dantian, his talent was even more powerful than before. In less than three days, he has already broken through to the fifth level of Qi refining!"
"I believe that it will take less than a year to return to the top!"
In less than three days, he broke through the fourth level one after another. This speed is enough to be recorded in the history of Purple Curtain Mountain!
Su Jinsheng naturally knew what Lin Yueshu was thinking, but he didn't point it out and smiled calmly.
"That's for sure, I will still protect you when the time comes!"
"Even the general manager wouldn't dare to assign you tasks at will!"
Although the handyman manager is the biggest among the handyman disciples, he is nothing more than an ant to the inner disciples.
Previously, when Su Jinsheng was the first disciple of the inner sect, every time he went to visit Lin Yueshu.
Hu Yufeng would come to flatter him.
He even takes care of Lin Yueshu and doesn't give him any tasks.
It can be said that in the past few years, Lin Yueshu was just about to be sacrificed among the handyman disciples.
"Then I'll just wait!"
Lin Yueshu looked happy on the surface, but secretly thought in her heart, in fact, those few years were quite boring.
I don’t have many friends, I just hang out all day, and I haven’t been able to make a breakthrough in my cultivation.
The happiest time was when Su Jinsheng came to visit her. That way, this life would not be so boring.
